prompt: The working week should be shorter and workers should have a longer weekend.Do you agree or disagree?Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
In today's high-paced world, it is imperative to strike a work-life balance for one's own well-being. It is suggested that having shorter working hours can be beneficial for employees. I strongly agree with this opinion.This essay will discuss the reasons why a longer weekend is preferable.

One of the desirable benefits of a shorter working week is that it can boost staff’s productivity.Having enough time to unwind after a long working week can help employees to refresh their minds and be ready to go back to work full of energy. Those well-rested staff can establish an enjoyable and welcoming working environment. This compound effect can enhance overall performance of the team.To illustrate, a tech company in Singapore changed their working hours to flexible four working days a week. The staff’s performance and productivity has been proven to be better than before. They take fewer sick leaves and the same amount of work is done.

Moreover,  a longer weekend can enhance workers’ social life. As there is more free time to enjoy, they can create more quality time with their loved ones. Maintaining social interactions is an integral part of human beings as social creatures. With extra hours, more time is devoted to doing exercise or working out, which can shape one to become a more well-rounded person. A physically and mentally healthy soul is way more active and creative than a tired one. Good performance at work can somehow lead to a sense of job satisfaction and better career prospects.

In conclusion, working longer hours can do more harm than good as it can drain individuals both physical and mental energy. Therefore, I strongly believe it would be immensely helpful if more time is devoted to recharge oneself fully.
